description: This Java interface defines methods for reading account number format data within the Fineract infrastructure, including retrieving all formats, specific formats by ID, and template data for a specific entity account type.

classes.name: AccountNumberFormatReadPlatformService
classes.description: Interface providing methods to read account number format data.

methods.name: getAllAccountNumberFormats
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all account number formats.

methods.name: getAccountNumberFormat
methods.description: Retrieves a specific account number format by its ID.

methods.name: retrieveTemplate
methods.description: Retrieves a template account number format for a given entity account type.
